name: SPRAT: Side-coupled Photonic-crystal Resonator Analysis Toolkit
description: Two-dimensional FDTD (Meep), MPB and plane-wave-expansion workflow for a point-defect microcavity side-coupled to a W1 waveguide in a square lattice of dielectric rods immersed in a liquid analyte, with a text-file structure and parameter interface, a workstation parallel runner, an English record schema, the analysis layer (including the comparison of the transmission spectra under the two guide terminations) and the figures of the accompanying paper.

referencePublication.name: Discrete quality-factor control in a side-coupled photonic crystal microcavity: evanescent Bloch tunnelling and the finite-cell correction
